preconditions.description: The number of rows and columns must be between 1 and 500.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a[i][j] <= 1023 for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
preconditions.description: All elements in the matrix must be between 0 and 1023.

postconditions.description: The output must either be 'NIE' or start with 'TAK'.
If the output starts with 'TAK', it must be followed by exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'NIE' or all(1 <= int(c) <= m for c in return_value.split()[1:])
postconditions.description: Each selected column index must be between 1 and m.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'NIE' or (return_value.startswith('TAK') and any(a[i][int(c) - 1] for i, c in enumerate(return_value.split()[1:])))
postconditions.description: At least one selected element must be non-zero.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'NIE' or (return_value.startswith('TAK') and (sum(a[i][int(c) - 1] for i, c in enumerate(return_value.split()[1:])) > 0))
postconditions.description: The bitwise XOR of the selected elements must be strictly greater than zero.
